name: extent
stmt: def extent {O A : Type*} (R : O → A → Prop) (B : Set A) : Set O
proof: {o : O | ∀ a : A, a ∈ B → R o a}

name: intent
stmt: def intent {O A : Type*} (R : O → A → Prop) (O' : Set O) : Set A
proof: {a : A | ∀ o : O, o ∈ O' → R o a}

name: extent_antitone
proof:
by
  intro o ho a ha
  exact ho a (h ha)

name: intent_antitone
proof:
by
  intro a ha o ho
  exact ha o (h ho)

name: subset_extent_intent
stmt:
theorem subset_extent_intent {O A : Type*} (R : O → A → Prop) (O' : Set O) :
    O' ⊆ extent R (intent R O')
proof:
by
  intro o ho a ha
  exact ha o ho

name: subset_intent_extent
stmt:
theorem subset_intent_extent {O A : Type*} (R : O → A → Prop) (B : Set A) :
    B ⊆ intent R (extent R B)
proof:
by
  intro a ha o ho
  exact ho a ha

name: galois_connection
stmt:
theorem galois_connection {O A : Type*} (R : O → A → Prop) (O' : Set O) (B : Set A) :
    O' ⊆ extent R B ↔ B ⊆ intent R O'
proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro h a ha o ho
                                                         
    exact h ho a ha
  · intro h o ho a ha
                                             
    exact h ha o ho

name: closure_idempotent
stmt:
theorem closure_idempotent {O A : Type*} (R : O → A → Prop) (O' : Set O) :
    extent R (intent R (extent R (intent R O'))) = extent R (intent R O')
proof:
by
  apply Set.ext
  intro o
  constructor
  ·                                                         
                                                           
    exact fun ho => (extent_antitone R (subset_intent_extent R (intent R O'))) ho
  ·                                                         
                                                        
    intro ho
    exact (extent_antitone R (intent_antitone R (subset_extent_intent R O'))) ho

name: intent_closure_idempotent
stmt:
theorem intent_closure_idempotent {O A : Type*} (R : O → A → Prop) (O' : Set O) :
    intent R (extent R (intent R O')) = intent R O'
proof:
by
  apply Set.ext
  intro a
  constructor
  ·                                         
                                            
    exact fun ha => (intent_antitone R (subset_extent_intent R O')) ha
  ·                                             
    exact fun ha => (subset_intent_extent R (intent R O')) ha

name: IsFormalConcept
stmt: def IsFormalConcept {O A : Type*} (R : O → A → Prop) (O' : Set O) (B : Set A) : Prop
proof: O' = extent R B ∧ B = intent R O'

name: formal_concept_iff_closure
stmt:
theorem formal_concept_iff_closure {O A : Type*} (R : O → A → Prop) (O' : Set O) (B : Set A) :
    IsFormalConcept R O' B ↔ (O' = extent R (intent R O') ∧ B = intent R O')
proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro h
    constructor
    ·                                                                 
      calc
        O' = extent R B := h.1
        _ = extent R (intent R O') := by rw [h.2]
    · exact h.2
  · intro h
    constructor
    · rw [h.2]
      exact h.1
    · exact h.2

name: concept_extraction_idempotent
stmt:
theorem concept_extraction_idempotent {O A : Type*} (R : O → A → Prop) (O' : Set O) (B : Set A)
    (h : IsFormalConcept R O' B) :
    IsFormalConcept R (extent R (intent R O')) (intent R O')
proof:
by
  constructor
  ·                                              
    rfl
  ·                                                  
    exact (intent_closure_idempotent R O').symm

name: IsSubconcept
stmt: def IsSubconcept {O A : Type*} (R : O → A → Prop) (C₁ C₂ : Set O × Set A) : Prop

name: subconcept_trans
stmt:
theorem subconcept_trans {O A : Type*} (R : O → A → Prop) (C₁ C₂ C₃ : Set O × Set A)
    (h₁₂ : IsSubconcept R C₁ C₂) (h₂₃ : IsSubconcept R C₂ C₃) :
    IsSubconcept R C₁ C₃
proof:
by
  unfold IsSubconcept at *
  exact fun o ho => h₂₃ (h₁₂ ho)

name: extent_intent_extent
stmt:
theorem extent_intent_extent {O A : Type*} (R : O → A → Prop) (B : Set A) :
    extent R (intent R (extent R B)) = extent R B
proof:
by
  apply Set.ext
  intro o
  constructor
  ·                                                                           
    exact fun ho => (extent_antitone R (subset_intent_extent R B)) ho
  ·                                          
    exact fun ho => (subset_extent_intent R (extent R B)) ho

name: concept_meet
stmt: def concept_meet {O A : Type*} (R : O → A → Prop) (C₁ C₂ : Set O × Set A) : Set O × Set A

name: concept_meet_is_concept
stmt:
theorem concept_meet_is_concept {O A : Type*} (R : O → A → Prop) (C₁ C₂ : Set O × Set A)
    (h₁ : IsFormalConcept R C₁.1 C₁.2) (h₂ : IsFormalConcept R C₂.1 C₂.2) :
    IsFormalConcept R (concept_meet R C₁ C₂).1 (concept_meet R C₁ C₂).2
proof:
by
  unfold concept_meet
  constructor
  ·                                         
    apply Set.ext
    intro o
    constructor
    ·                                             
      exact fun ho => (subset_extent_intent R (C₁.1 ∩ C₂.1)) ho
    ·                                         
      intro ho
      constructor
      ·                                                                   
        have hsub : extent R (intent R (C₁.1 ∩ C₂.1)) ⊆ C₁.1 := by
          calc
            extent R (intent R (C₁.1 ∩ C₂.1)) ⊆ extent R (intent R C₁.1) := by
                                                                       
              exact extent_antitone R (intent_antitone R (by
                exact Set.inter_subset_left : C₁.1 ∩ C₂.1 ⊆ C₁.1))
            _ = C₁.1 := by
                                                                                                 
              rw [← h₁.2, ← h₁.1]
        exact hsub ho
      ·                
        have hsub₂ : extent R (intent R (C₁.1 ∩ C₂.1)) ⊆ C₂.1 := by
          calc
            extent R (intent R (C₁.1 ∩ C₂.1)) ⊆ extent R (intent R C₂.1) := by
              exact extent_antitone R (intent_antitone R (by
                exact Set.inter_subset_right : C₁.1 ∩ C₂.1 ⊆ C₂.1))
            _ = C₂.1 := by
              rw [← h₂.2, ← h₂.1]
        exact hsub₂ ho
  ·                                                    
    rfl

name: concept_join
stmt: def concept_join {O A : Type*} (R : O → A → Prop) (C₁ C₂ : Set O × Set A) : Set O × Set A
proof: (extent R (C₁.2 ∩ C₂.2), intent R (extent R (C₁.2 ∩ C₂.2)))

name: concept_join_is_concept
stmt:
theorem concept_join_is_concept {O A : Type*} (R : O → A → Prop) (C₁ C₂ : Set O × Set A) :
    IsFormalConcept R (concept_join R C₁ C₂).1 (concept_join R C₁ C₂).2
proof:
by
  unfold concept_join
  constructor
  ·                                                         
    exact (extent_intent_extent R (C₁.2 ∩ C₂.2)).symm
  · rfl

               
                                 
                           
                                 
                               
                      
                                    
                                              
                                   

end Lattice
